verdict.rationale: Ledgy documents bulk granting, document and signature workflow automation, so the automation-depth axis applies. However, no evidence shows that these automations can be versioned, reviewed before change, or rolled back. The only lifecycle text concerns credential rotation and revocation and a legacy API-key deprecation note, which are adjacent controls and not automation version control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
